mapper.sql: w.id, w.project_id, w.name, w.description, w.created_by, w.deleted, w.created_at, w.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wb_workflow_node n WHERE n.workflow_id = w.id) AS node_count FROM wb_workflow w WHERE w.project_id = #{projectId} AND w.deleted = 0 ORDER BY w.created_at DESC, w.id DESC
SELECT FROM wb_workflow w WHERE w.id = #{id} AND w.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wb_workflow (project_id, name, description, created_by, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{createdBy}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, workflow_id, seq, name, description, input_type, created_at, updated_at FROM wb_workflow_node WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} ORDER BY seq ASC, id ASC

SELECT n.id AS node_id, n.seq AS node_seq, n.name AS node_name, n.description AS node_description, n.input_type AS node_input_type, s.id AS skill_id, s.name AS skill_name, ns.seq AS skill_seq, i.id AS input_item_id, i.seq AS input_seq, i.name AS input_name, i.description AS input_description, i.file_kind AS input_file_kind, i.required AS input_required, o.id AS output_item_id, o.seq AS output_seq, o.item_key AS output_item_key, o.name AS output_name, o.description AS output_description, o.file_kind AS output_file_kind, o.required AS output_required FROM wb_workflow_node n LEFT JOIN wb_workflow_node_skill ns ON ns.node_id = n.id LEFT JOIN wb_skill s ON s.id = ns.skill_id LEFT JOIN wb_node_input_item i ON i.node_id = n.id LEFT JOIN wb_node_output_item o ON o.node_id = n.id WHERE n.workflow_id = #{workflowId} ORDER BY n.seq ASC, n.id ASC, ns.seq ASC, i.seq ASC, o.seq ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wb_workflow_node (workflow_id, seq, name, description, input_type, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workflowId}, #{seq}, #{name}, #{description}, #{inputType}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE ns FROM wb_workflow_node_skill ns JOIN wb_workflow_node n ON n.id = ns.node_id WHERE n.workflow_id = #{workflowId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wb_workflow_node_skill (node_id, skill_id, seq) VALUES (#{nodeId}, #{skillId}, #{seq})
mapper.delete: DELETE i FROM wb_node_input_item i JOIN wb_workflow_node n ON n.id = i.node_id WHERE n.workflow_id = #{workflowId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wb_node_input_item (node_id, seq, name, description, file_kind, required, created_at) VALUES (#{nodeId}, #{seq}, #{name}, #{description}, #{fileKind}, #{required}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE o FROM wb_node_output_item o JOIN wb_workflow_node n ON n.id = o.node_id WHERE n.workflow_id = #{workflowId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wb_node_output_item (node_id, seq, item_key, name, description, file_kind, required, created_at) VALUES (#{nodeId}, #{seq}, #{itemKey}, #{name}, #{description}, #{fileKind}, #{required}, #{createdAt})
